llms.body:
# SSENSE

> SSENSE is a Montréal-based online retailer of luxury fashion, emerging designers and streetwear for men and women, shipping globally. The catalogue covers clothing, shoes, bags, accessories and home & lifestyle ("Everything Else").

## When to use SSENSE

Use SSENSE when a shopper wants to:

- Find, compare or buy luxury, designer or streetwear clothing, shoes, bags and accessories for men or women
- Check current price, size availability or shipping for a specific designer product
- Browse a designer's current collection (e.g. Acne Studios, Rick Owens, Maison Margiela)
- Read SSENSE's shipping, returns, payment or sizing policies before or after an order

Do not use SSENSE for: wholesale or B2B purchasing, resale of used items, or order-specific account actions (tracking, returns), which require the shopper to sign in.

## Notes for agents


- URLs are localized as `/{language}-{country}/...` (e.g. `/en-us`, `/en-ca`, `/fr-ca`, `/en-gb`, `/ja-jp`). Prices, availability and shipping depend on the country in the URL. The examples below use `en-us`; swap in the shopper's locale.
- Product listing pages accept filters in the path, e.g. `/en-us/women/designers/{designer}` or `/en-us/men/{category}`.
- Product pages live at `/{locale}/{men|women|everything-else}/product/{designer}/{product-name}/{product-id}` and include schema.org `Product` JSON-LD with price, currency and availability.
- Checkout, account, shopping bag and wishlist pages require a signed-in or interactive session and are disallowed in robots.txt.
- Sitemaps: https://www.ssense.com/sitemap.xml

## Shop

- [Women](https://www.ssense.com/en-us/women): Women's new arrivals and full catalogue
- [Men](https://www.ssense.com/en-us/men): Men's new arrivals and full catalogue
- [Everything Else](https://www.ssense.com/en-us/everything-else): Home, lifestyle, beauty and objects
- [Women's designers](https://www.ssense.com/en-us/women/designers): A–Z list of designers carried for women
- [Men's designers](https://www.ssense.com/en-us/men/designers): A–Z list of designers carried for men
- [Editorial](https://www.ssense.com/en-us/editorial): Fashion, culture and music stories

## Customer service

- [Customer service](https://www.ssense.com/en-us/customer-service): Help centre overview
- [Shipping](https://www.ssense.com/en-us/customer-service/shipping): Shipping methods, delivery times and duties by country
- [Return policy](https://www.ssense.com/en-us/customer-service/return-policy): Return eligibility, windows and process
- [Payment information](https://www.ssense.com/en-us/customer-service/payment-info): Accepted payment methods
- [Product information](https://www.ssense.com/en-us/customer-service/product-info): Sizing, authenticity and product care
- [FAQ](https://www.ssense.com/en-us/customer-service/faq): Frequently asked questions
- [Contact us](https://www.ssense.com/en-us/customer-service/contact-us): Contact options; email customercare@ssense.com

## Company

- [About us](https://www.ssense.com/en-us/customer-service/about-us): About SSENSE
- [Privacy policy](https://www.ssense.com/en-us/privacy-policy)
- [Terms & conditions](https://www.ssense.com/en-us/terms-conditions)
